entities.summary: JoAnn Hardin Morgan is an American aerospace engineer who was the first female engineer at the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) John F. Kennedy Space Center and the first woman to serve as a senior executive at Kennedy Space Center. For her work at NASA, Morgan was honored by U.S. President Bill Clinton as a Meritorious Executive in 1995 and 1998. Prior to her retirement in 2003, she held various leadership positions over 40 years in the human space flight programs at NASA. Morgan served as the director of the External Relations and Business Development during her final years at the space center.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a pioneering female engineer at NASA, JoAnn Morgan played a crucial role in shaping the US space program during her 40-year career. Her leadership and contributions paved the way for future generations of women in STEM fields.
